title: Grateful Dead Live at The Scope on 1982-04-03
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/44.1k) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB) Nakamichi 700 (With Bass EQ) -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell XLIIS/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: Stellar audience capture of an ’82 show featuring a smoking Scarlet > Fire and a standout Brent keyboard solo on Never Trust A Woman.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as phenomenal for an audience source, with crystal‑clear ambience that lets the band’s energy shine through. Reviewers highlight a tight first set, a powerful pre‑drums jam, and especially the Scarlet Begonias → Fire on the Mountain sequence plus Brent Mydland’s unforgettable Never Trust A Woman solo. Overall sentiment is overwhelmingly positive, rating both the performance and the capture at the top of the Dead catalog.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high praise for both the show (multiple 5‑star mentions) and the audience recording quality; no negative feedback, yielding a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience recording described as stellar, crisp, and phenomenal with no noted drop‑outs or muffiness; reviewer even performed minor fades for a smooth ending.

standout_songs: Scarlet Begonias > Fire on the Mountain
show_quality.setlist_flow: Nice first set with strong pre‑drums jam; seamless transitions and high energy throughout.

band_member_comments.Keys: Brent Mydland delivers possibly his best solo on Never Trust A Woman, highlighted by reviewers.
band_member_comments.Drums: Pre‑drums segment noted as good, indicating solid rhythmic foundation.
